description: Measured grid uncertainty of the Rust Kohn-Sham solver (Revision/kohn_sham/solver) for EVERY state of the canonical matrix (75 ground, 135 thermal, 60 exact-Fock-variant states and the 5 slices of the crossing demonstration): |canonical - refined| of `revision_ks_solver single` (canonical: RK4 G = 900, root tolerance 1e-13, SCF tolerance 1e-11; refined: G = 1800, 1e-14, 1e-12, thermal cut 1e-14), with the label-set margin of the canonical matrix. The canonical single run reproduces the committed canonical matrix (canonical_single_vs_matrix).
